idea.idea: Automated Cyber Attacks Are Targeting SMB Billing PCs: 4 Defense Steps
idea.angle: AI agents are now used by attackers to scan and breach unpatched remote desktop software on small business systems.
idea.audience_problem: Traders assume hackers only target large tech firms, leaving their billing PCs, GST software, and remote desktops vulnerable.

hooks: Hackers are using AI to target your billing PC right now.
Small businesses are being hit by 3,000 login attempts every minute.
Think your shop's billing software is too small to be hacked?
piece.hook_reason: It uses a specific, alarming statistic from the source to immediately capture attention by highlighting the sheer scale of the threat.
piece.title: Protect Your Billing PC From AI Attacks

scenes.purpose: Hook the viewer with the scale of the threat.
scenes.narration: Small businesses are being hit by 3,000 login attempts every minute. Hackers now use AI to find weak spots.
scenes.headline: 3,000 attacks per minute

scenes.narration: If you use remote access for your billing software or site management, you are a prime target for these agents.
scenes.on_screen: Remote access is the weak link

scenes.narration: You must secure your systems before a breach happens. Check these four steps to harden your billing PC today.
scenes.headline: Lock down your billing PC

scenes.narration: First, force Multi-Factor Authentication on every account. Second, revoke old API keys. Third, restrict remote access hours.

scenes.purpose: Explain the limitation and final advice.
scenes.narration: Software updates cannot stop every breach if your passwords are weak. Always use unique, strong credentials for every login.
scenes.headline: Updates are not enough

piece.caption: Is your shop's billing software secure? Hackers are using AI frameworks like ARTEX to scan for weak security and lack of Multi-Factor Authentication on thousands of systems. Even if you are a small trader, your remote access setup could be the entry point for an automated attack. Don't wait for a data breach to audit your setup. Start by turning on MFA for your cloud billing and remote desktop tools today. Review your software's security settings and ensure no old API keys are still active. What is the biggest security hurdle you face when setting up your shop's digital tools?
